WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, '(no state recorded)') AS state_province,
         COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
  FROM Customers c
  JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, '(no state recorded)')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT account_count,
         1.0 * account_count / SUM(account_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
),
summary AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.account_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - summary.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN summary
WHERE s.share > summary.average_share
